name: Authelia
description: Lightweight single sign-on and two-factor portal for Traefik forward authentication, with file-backed users (no database or LDAP needed).

inputs.label: Protected domain
inputs.help: Your domain, e.g. example.com. Authelia's session cookie needs a real domain (not localhost) and HTTPS.

inputs.label: Sign-in subdomain
inputs.help: The portal will live at https://<this>.<domain> once you publish it.

files.content:
---
# Authelia configuration, generated once by the Deployment Manager. Edit freely: it is never overwritten.
# Secrets come from the files in ../secrets (AUTHELIA_*_FILE variables), not from this file.
server:
  address: 'tcp://:9091'
log:
  level: 'info'
totp:
  issuer: '{{input:domain}}'
authentication_backend:
  file:
    path: '/config/users_database.yml'
access_control:
  default_policy: 'deny'
  rules:
    - domain: '*.{{input:domain}}'
      policy: 'one_factor'
session:
  cookies:
    - name: 'authelia_session'
      domain: '{{input:domain}}'
      authelia_url: 'https://{{input:authHost}}.{{input:domain}}'
      expiration: '1 hour'
      inactivity: '5 minutes'
regulation:
  max_retries: 3
  find_time: '2 minutes'
  ban_time: '5 minutes'
storage:
  local:
    path: '/data/db.sqlite3'
notifier:
  filesystem:
    filename: '/data/notification.txt'
...

# Authelia users. Hash new passwords with: docker exec <container> authelia crypto hash generate argon2 --password '<password>'
users:
  {{input:adminUser}}:
    disabled: false
    displayname: '{{input:adminUser}}'
    password: '{{input:adminHash}}'
    email: '{{input:adminEmail}}'
    groups:
      - 'admins'

security: Authelia protects apps only once Traefik forwards authentication to it (a forwardAuth middleware) and the portal is published over HTTPS; installing it changes no existing route.
The administrator password is hashed with argon2 on this PC by Authelia itself; the plain password is kept only in credentials.txt (readable by your account).

notes: Authelia is itself a sign-in provider; its portal is never put behind ForwardAuth.

limitations: Session cookies need a real domain with HTTPS: it protects apps only after a public or LAN hostname is configured.

update.notes: Read the release notes: configuration keys are occasionally renamed between minor versions.

testStatus.notes: Installed in isolation: /api/health, Traefik route, backup and restore (2026-11-16). ForwardAuth with Authelia not implemented.
